local_articles.snippet: st-ever World Cup knockout for Egypt, who made their tournament debut in 1934. More World Cup history beckons for Messi This tournament’s Golden Boot race is one for the ages. Argentina legend Messi, France’s Kylian Mbappe and Norway’s Erling Haaland are all tied at seven goals, with Mbappe leading the list, his two assists breaking the tie. If Messi – who has scored in each of Argentina’s four games so far – finds the net against Egypt, not only will he become the Golden Boot leader, but he will also join Guillermo Stabile (1930) as the only Argentina player to score eight goals in a single World Cup. But ahead of Tuesday’s last-16 tie, there have been concerns about fatigue, and it’s not just limited to Messi.
